purpose: Tune the repository improvement loop without optimizing away evidence quality.
inner_loop: observe -> biopsy -> competing explanations -> smallest reversible change -> verify -> promote -> re-observe
outer_loop: measure inner-loop telemetry -> locate dominant friction -> propose bounded tuning -> verify guardrails -> adopt tuning -> remeasure
immutable_guardrails: A failed invariant is a specimen, not permission to weaken the invariant.
Story/concept/visualization must not be promoted to observed fact without evidence.
UNKNOWN does not create action authority.
No meta metric is allowed to become a single overall success score.
Cycle speed is diagnostic telemetry, not the North Star.
Deleting checks merely to reduce latency is not a valid tuning action.

tunable_surfaces.objective: reduce redundant verification work without weakening merge gates
reduce agent search/path length without instruction bloat

examples: separate local-actionable work from external-evidence-blocked work
tunable_surfaces.objective: avoid waiting on unavailable evidence while preserving the blocked frontier
keep measurement machinery from becoming the dominant maintenance burden

trigger_rules.recommendation: Improve critic localization and task routing before reducing verification.
Investigate parallelism/caching/change-sensitive staging while keeping full promotion gates.
Reduce manual promotion friction only after required verification is complete.
Add cheaper intermediate validation near the failure source.
Audit measurement duplication and projection cost. Soft design threshold, not empirical optimum.

anti_goodhart: Do not optimize commit count, PR count, file count, cat count, or raw cycle count as success.
Do not turn Purrtocol delight into a fake scientific score.
Do not treat fewer failures as success if failures disappeared because observation was removed.
Do not treat lower CI runtime as improvement if coverage or evidence checks were weakened.
Do not treat theoretical genotype space as external adoption.

recursion_policy.rationale: The meta loop observes its own footprint through the Repository Observatory instead of recursively creating higher-order controllers.

success_requires: post-tuning median observation-to-first-change is lower than the frozen baseline
no critical evidence/lineage/standards guardrail is weakened
observer footprint remains below soft design warnings
first_tuning_evaluation.note: A single faster cycle is not sufficient evidence that the loop improved.
